# Security policy

## Supported versions

This repository is an unaudited alpha prototype. No version is recommended for production use or real funds.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/NexaStellar/soroban-payment-gateway/security/advisories/new).
Do not include exploit details, private keys, seed phrases, or account credentials in a public issue.

Reports should include the affected commit or release, impact, and concise reproduction steps. The maintainers will acknowledge reports and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available.

## Safe handling

Never commit secrets or funded account credentials. Test contract changes only in Soroban's local environment or on a test network. Do not deploy this prototype with real funds.
